{"metadata":{"description":"Delete DSH conversations instead of archiving them, see the whole family a conversation spawned (its subagents and derived conversations), and delete in bulk. / 真正删除 DeepSeek Harness 里的会话，并看清它生出的子智能体与派生对话。","id":"gh:1396543508","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"better-dsh-session-deletetool","slug":"Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-desktop","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Delete DSH conversations instead of archiving them, see the whole family a conversation spawned (its"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" subagents and derived conversations), and delete in bulk. / 真正删除 DeepSeek Harness 里的会话，并看清它生出的子智能体与"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"gents and derived conversations), and delete in bulk. / 真正删除 DeepSeek Harness 里的会话，并看清它生出的子智能体与派生对话。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# better-dsh-session-deletetool"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Delete a DeepSeek Harness conversation for real, and manage the whole family around it.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DSH ships archive only. This plugin adds a real delete — session log, Workspace account, archive/pin"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"
membership and projection-cache record — and surrounds it with the numbers and folders you need to
"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"decide what to remove."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"中文说明"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it adds"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Real delete.** The log directory goes, the Workspace record forgets the session, archive and pin"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"
membership are cleared, and the projection-cache record is dropped. DSH's own archive only hides.
-"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" **The conversation family, as a tree.** A main conversation, its forked conversations and its
subag"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ents, nested by `parentSession` — a subagent that spawned its own subagent sits one level
deeper. In"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" the single dialog a parent click selects only that node (blank until it is selected,
then green, ye"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"llow or red for itself / some descendants / the whole family), and the top
Select all box takes the "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"whole family.
- **Usage per conversation.** A node counts only the requests it made itself. A parent"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" also shows
`own/family`, the family total after a slash.
- **Three-way token bar.** Cache-hit input"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" (green), cache-miss input (blue), output (yellow), with the
three percentages underneath. Cache hit"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" rate = hit / (hit + miss + write).
- **Fork-aware counting.** A forked conversation's inherited log"},{"id":"p7s11","text":" prefix is skipped, and requests are
de-duplicated by message id, so a fork never re-counts its pare"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"nt's past.
- **Local folders.** A folder button on every row opens that node's directory. The Host r"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"esolves the
path through `sessionPersistence.locate`; it is never rebuilt from a conversation title."},{"id":"p7s14","text":"
- **Bulk management.** One card per family with search, sort by last activity / tokens / hit rate,
"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"filters by kind and Workspace, paging, per-page select, delete selected, and delete all behind a
sec"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ond confirmation.
- **Cache controls.** Open DSH's projection-cache folder, and read what that folde"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"r is under the action bar.
- **Usage switch.** Turn usage off and the Host stops reading session log"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"s entirely; token and cache figures read “Off”."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"All routes go through DSH's plugin manager:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- GitHub: `plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "github:Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-d"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"eletetool" }`
- Local copy: `plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute path to t"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"he unpacked folder>" }`
- Tarball: `https://github.com/Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool/archi"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ve/refs/heads/main.tar.gz`"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Refresh the page after installing. Changes to the Host half need a full restart of DSH."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"To remove: `plugin_manager { action: "remove_bundle", target: "better-dsh-session-deletetool" }`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**One conversation.** Open a session's `⋯` menu and pick **Delete conversation**. The dialog shows t"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"he
family tree, that conversation's own usage and family total, the cache split, and a folder button"},{"id":"p15s3","text":", that conversation's own usage and family total, the cache split, and a folder button on
every row."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Bulk.** Press the trash control in the Workspace header, left of the search icon. Each family is a"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"
card; tick rows, filter, sort, page, then delete the selection or every conversation."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Before deleting, the Host asks DSH's own activity admission. Running work is reported; it is stopped"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"
only after you confirm."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## HTTP surface"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Same-origin routes on `ctx.webServer`:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Route | Method | Purpose |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/inspect?sessionId=…` | GET | state, family rows, usage and folder "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"per node |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/delete` | POST | `{ sessionId, stop?, descendants? }` |"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/catalog` | GET | every session with usage and folder, plus a corp"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"us summary |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/delete-batch` | POST | `{ roots: [{ sessionId, descen"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"dants? }], stop?, cleanCache? }` |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/open-directory` | POST | `{ ses"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"sionId }` — open that session's folder |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/open-cache` | POST | open"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" DSH's projection-cache folder |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/refresh-stats` | POST | drop the "},{"id":"p21s8","text":"plugin's cached usage folds |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Every route carries a loopback and same-origin gate, so another page cannot reach them."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Layout"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| File | Role |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `host.js` | Host half: the routes, removal, family walk, catalog and corpus totals |
| `session-mo"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"del.js` | Usage folding, directory resolution, cache invalidation |
| `client.js` | Client half: the"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" menu row, the bulk control, and the two dialogs |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the Host row into "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"the profile's layer stack |
| `test/host.test.mjs` | Route tests over real temporary directories |
|"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" `icon.svg` | Plugin artwork |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Styles use host theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`) only, so light and dark both read; the UI is localize"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"d
(English / 简体中文) through the Client locale service."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Known limits"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Fork lineage is read from `inheritedEventCount`. This build has no fork sample, so that path follo"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ws
the field's meaning but has not been exercised against real data.
- A session whose folder the ba"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ckend cannot locate keeps its folder button disabled, with the reason
in its tooltip.
- Usage is fol"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ded from each log on first read; later reads reuse a size + mtime cache. About ninety
sessions fold "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"in under a second on this machine."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Thanks"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Issues and reports that shaped this version:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- @rowan-firm
